items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Interviewer asks: 'did you know Tom Brown, got to hear him when you were young?' Interviewee responds: 'Yeah, they were terrific. They came up here.'

ctx.x: That's Steve's brother. And there was another, there was Steve, Tom, there was another one. I don't think he played anything. He was a tin smith. They were all tin smiths.
Oh yeah. They even made violins and basses out of tin. Steve told me about it.
